name: How long does a typical rental property renovation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical rental property renovation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a rental property renovation varies based on scope. Minor cosmetic updates like painting and flooring might take 1-3 weeks. A full kitchen or bathroom remodel could extend to 3-6 weeks. Whole-house renovations, especially those involving layout changes, can take 2-4 months or more. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on scope, from 1-3 weeks for minor updates to several months for extensive renovations.
